name: pl-pacsretrieve
title: PACS Retrieve
description: An app to both query a PACS and also retrieve a series of interest.

parameters.name: str_pfdcm
parameters.help: The PACS Q/R intermediary service IP:port.

parameters.name: str_msg
parameters.help: The actual complete JSON message to send to the Q/R intermediary service.

parameters.name: str_indexList
parameters.help: A comma separated list of indices into the priorHitsTable.

parameters.name: str_priorHitsTable
parameters.help: A JSON formatted file returned by a prior call to pacsquery.

parameters.name: str_PACSservice
parameters.help: The PACS service to use. Note this a key to a lookup in "pfdcm".

parameters.name: str_pullDirTemplate
parameters.help: A template for directory names when pulled from "pfdcm".

parameters.name: str_seriesSummaryKeys
parameters.help: If specified, generate a summary report for series based on a comma separated key list.

parameters.name: str_seriesSummaryFile
parameters.help: If specified, save (overwrite) a series summary report to passed file (in outputdir).

parameters.name: str_studySummaryKeys
parameters.help: If specified, generate a summary report for study data based on a comma separated key list.

parameters.name: str_studySummaryFile
parameters.help: If specified, save (overwrite) a study summary report to passed file (in outputdir).

parameters.name: str_numberOfHitsFile
parameters.help: If specified, save (overwrite) the number of hits (in outputdir).

parameters.name: str_resultFile
parameters.help: If specified, save (overwrite) all the hits to the passed file (in outputdir).

parameters.name: str_man
parameters.help: If specified, print help on the passed key entry. Use "entries" for all key list

parameters.name: str_action
parameters.help: The action to perform. Default is "retrieve".

parameters.name: b_jpgPreview
parameters.help: Generate a local jpg preview of received DICOM data.
